name: R1_CASH_SURPLUS
hypothesis: Cash-backed reported profits may be more persistent than accrual-heavy profits. Same-period cash-to-profit algebra must reconcile; this is a revenue-scaled cash surplus proxy, not the original assets-scaled Sloan factor.

name: R1_CASH_IMPROVEMENT
hypothesis: Same-season improvement in cash support may precede broader recognition of improving earnings quality.

name: R1_GROSS_MARGIN_CHANGE
hypothesis: Same-season gross-margin improvement may reflect pricing power or operating-cost improvement that diffuses into prices slowly. It is not analyst earnings surprise.

name: R1_NET_MARGIN_CHANGE
hypothesis: Same-season net-margin improvement may contain persistent operating information beyond technical features. It is not a revived raw ROE or net-profit-growth factor.

name: R1_QUIET_REVERSAL
hypothesis: Recent moves with subdued participation may reflect transient price pressure and partially reverse over the predeclared 20-day target.

name: R1_ACTIVE_CONTINUATION
hypothesis: Sustained price movement with elevated participation may reflect gradual information incorporation. Expected overlap with Alpha158 is a falsifiable concern, not evidence of independence.
